drafted_from: tool row in tools/work-on-connected-drives/tool-rows.json, code in read-data/drives.mjs and read-data/file-transfer.mjs, test/drives.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check what copying /Volumes/Card/DCIM to /Volumes/Backup/Footage would do, change nothing." It runs tool:trillion-media-transfer with check true and tells you whether the copy is ready; then say "Do it" and it starts the copy.
no_lists_because: It copies or moves the files and folders it is given between connected drives and keeps no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Connect the drives, then note the full paths: what to copy (files or folders, for example /Volumes/Card/DCIM) and the folder on a connected drive it goes to (for example /Volumes/Backup/Footage).

2. Run it first with check true: tools:run tool:trillion-media-transfer with {"sources":["/Volumes/Card/DCIM"],"destinations":["/Volumes/Backup/Footage"],"mode":"copy","check":true}. It changes nothing and answers ready true with the real paths, or an error saying what to change.

3. Run it again without check (or with check false) to start the job. It copies, checks each copy by its BLAKE3 content identity and only then names it; a name already taken gets the next free one (clip 2.mov). A move sends the source to the Trash only after every copy was checked.
4. The job runs in the background and can be paused or stopped; follow it with tool:trillion-media-work and change it with tool:trillion-media-work-control.

worked_examples.title: Check a copy of a card to a backup drive without changing anything
worked_examples.ask: Check what copying my card's DCIM folder to the Backup drive's Footage folder would do, change nothing.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/work-on-connected-drives/read-data/drives.mjs (transfer) and read-data/file-transfer.mjs (preview, validate); test/drives.test.mjs runs the real copy on pretend drives. I could not run it here: it needs a Mac with drives mounted under /Volumes. Synthetic setup: drives Card and Backup are connected, /Volumes/Card/DCIM is a folder and /Volumes/Backup/Footage is a folder.
worked_examples.hands_back: The answer's result is {"ready":true,"sources":["/Volumes/Card/DCIM"],"destinations":["/Volumes/Backup/Footage"],"mode":"copy"} and nothing on either drive changed. With check left out the same input starts the job and answers {"id":"<a new job id>", ...the worker's progress}.
